name: pokemontcg-lister
description: Multi-account Pokémon TCG Pocket inventory, listings, and trade-job dispatch

scripts.dev: concurrently "nodemon server.js --ignore client/ --ignore .data/" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test: node --test routes/utils/jobPayload.test.js routes/utils/importers/pathGuard.test.js routes/utils/importers/ptcgpbAccount.test.js routes/utils/rules/engine.test.js routes/utils/routing/router.test.js routes/utils/aggregates.test.js agent/jobPayload.test.js
